svg.title: ESP: two clear words, then the ciphertext
svg.desc: The native ESP packet of frame 5 of ikev2_s2s_ipsec_vpn_aes_gcm.pcapng, IP protocol 50: the SPI 0x5fbd60dc and the sequence number 1 are the only fields the crate can read; the 8-byte AES-GCM IV that follows is in clear too, then 88 bytes of ciphertext (the inner packet, its padding and the next-header byte) and the 16-byte ICV; EspPacket keeps the SPI, the sequence and the 112 bytes after them as payload, and nothing is probed above it.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
